title: Video Quality Strategy
instructions: Complete `video/strategies.py`. Declare the abstract `QualityAdjustmentStrategy.adjust_quality(video)` and implement `LowQualityStrategy`, `MediumQualityStrategy` and `HighQualityStrategy`: each sets the video's `quality`, `codec` and `bitrate` as in the table and returns the same video. `VideoStreamingManager`, `Video` and the enums are provided.

evidence.label: QualityAdjustmentStrategy is an ABC and each level is a concrete strategy
Low sets quality Low, codec H264, bitrate 500
Medium sets quality Medium, codec H265, bitrate 1000
High sets quality High, codec VP9, bitrate 2000
Strategies return the same video object
The manager applies its strategy and returns the video
The strategy can be swapped at runtime
A custom strategy works without touching the manager
